about.description: ApeX Omni is the next-generation aggregated multichain decentralized derivatives exchange from ApeX Protocol, built by Davison Labs and backed by Bybit. It evolved from ApeX Pro (StarkEx-powered) into a modular intent-centric architecture spanning Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, and Mantle (via zkLink Nova). The platform offers stock and equity-index perpetuals alongside crypto with cross-collateral margining in USDT, zero gas fees on most actions, and high-leverage execution via a permissionless non-custodial design.
about.registryInfo: ApeX Omni is the next-generation permissionless DEX from ApeX Protocol, developed by Davison Labs and backed/incubated by Bybit. The earlier ApeX Pro product was powered by StarkWare's StarkEx Layer 2 scalability engine; ApeX Omni now operates on a multi-chain architecture aggregated via zkLink Nova (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Mantle).

fees.revenueNotes: ApeX Omni standard fees: 2 bps maker / 5 bps taker. Launch promotional tier (subject to change): 0 bps maker / 2.5 bps taker for accounts with ≤$500K 30-day volume, 0 bps maker / 5 bps taker for accounts above. Negative bot fees (-0.2 bps) and VIP rebates (up to -0.5 bps) available. No gas fees (L2 infrastructure). Source: https://www.apex.exchange/blog/detail/Enhancing-Your-Trading-Experience-on-ApeX-Omni-Fee-Structure-Updates
